findings.redBefore: A conforming WorkStore let automatic heartbeat IO remain pending. The caller AbortSignal aborted first with Error("caller-cancelled-first"), then the pending heartbeat rejected with Error("late-heartbeat-failure"). run.signal.reason retained the caller error, but runAvailable returned the later heartbeat error. This used createWorkOnce/runAvailable and normal adapter operations; no database tampering or audit-host interruption.
findings.repair: The heartbeat catch records ownership loss only when the claim controller is not already aborted, preserving caller cancellation or confirmed lease expiry as the first stop cause.
findings.formalGap: The previous local-runner observation set did not encode cancellation-before-late-heartbeat ordering. A firstStopCause observation now binds exact returned cause, exact signal cause, and durable running state; restoring the old overwrite is a causal compiled-runtime mutant and each boolean is independently mutation-checked by TLC.

findings.redBefore: Re-running the new missing-coverage controls against the exact pre-fix WorkOnceRuntime.tla and WorkOncePolicy.tla made each formal shard fail with an initial-state invariant violation: the old predicates accepted a missing local abortActive runner mode/site and accepted missing defer coverage in dual-outcome policy families.
findings.repair: RuntimeSamplesConform now requires the exact producer mode/site set (11 common sites for local/external plus two local-only abort sites). PolicySamplesConform now requires retry+defer for casAckLoss, receiptAcrossAttempts, and adapterEquivalence.
findings.formalNegativeControls: Runtime observed TLC removes the sole local abortActive sample; policy observed TLC independently removes defer from each of the three dual-outcome families. All must be rejected.

siblingAudit: Equivalent cross-dimensional coverage in local-runner, outbox, read-history, and storage predicates already binds exact adapter/mode or per-kind adapter domains. The current review exposed runtime mode/site and policy outcome-kind as the missing same-invariant cases; no audit-host crash/recovery hardening was added.
documentation: The duplicate storage-doc note was applied as neutral public-contract wording: due queries reject afterId; all/outbox support it.
